_about: Neverwhere cast record: the source of truth for every face and costume in Neverwhere's pictures and videos. The shot builder (Phase 5) attaches each character's approved sheet (and angle sheets once made) as references and leads every prompt with their lock text, so the owner's approved fixes are applied to every keyframe and therefore every clip. Every cast id in app/src/content/books/neverwhere/book.json must be listed here, as a character or as background; check-story fails otherwise. Approved = the owner chose it in chat (2026-10-24 round 1).

aurie.name: Aurie Mayhew
aurie.lock: Aurie is the real woman of the face photographs, exactly as in her approved sheet: a full, round, soft face made a little slimmer than in the photographs, almond eyes with subtle single eyelids, straight thick dark brows, a broad soft nose, a small mouth with a fuller lower lip; her own long dark hair; a curvy figure with slightly long legs. Her clothes are black (black cable-knit sweater, black jeans, black sneakers) unless the scene's look says otherwise. When she smiles or laughs, copy her own smile from the smile photographs exactly. Always clothed; never reshaped further.
aurie.notes: Owner: a little slimmer face, slightly longer legs, never over-changed; clothes in black; her real smile and laugh. Likeness gate 0.45; sheet scores 0.644.

looks.look: the night before London, three years younger: a black going-out top and black jeans, a black coat, holding a white umbrella printed with the Tube map, rain
London office worker: a black trouser suit, white shirt and black coat (she wore it to the dinner; it stays on, rumpled, through the Monday, the coat sleeve torn from 4.1)
her black cable-knit sweater, black jeans, black sneakers, the black sports bag, clean
the same black sweater and jeans now ruined: mud to the knees, bleached pale patches on the jeans where the gap's smoke touched (from 9.2), grime on her face and hands, hair tangled
the ruined sweater and jeans, now bloodied and torn; from the angel's hall (20.3) her little finger broken
a borrowed grey friar's robe of rough wool, her little finger splinted, a stitched cut by her ear; from 21.3 the black sports bag over her shoulder
Ending B, she never went up: her black sweater and jeans mended in Underside fashion under a long patched black leather coat, little finger healed crooked
Ending C, a Saturday in the penthouse: a clean black sweater and black jeans, little finger still splinted
back in London Above: a smart black office suit, her little finger still splinted

aurie-dream.name: Aurie as Dream (the library)
aurie-dream.lock: Aurie as Dream of the Endless, exactly as in the Sandman: her real face, raven-black hair, the long black high-collared gown with a faint starry shimmer, the pinpoints of starlight in her eyes. Only in Lucienne's library (Neverwhere 0.1, 0.2, the credits).

door.name: Door
door.lock: Door exactly as in her approved sheet: a pretty British Chinese woman of about twenty-two, petite and curvy, a pale heart-shaped face, fire-opal eyes, short choppy near-black hair with copper lights; a laced patchwork corset bodice of brocade and velvet with a low neckline, sheer black lace sleeves, a short layered rag skirt, laddered stockings, black boots, and the enormous brown leather flying jacket worn open. Alluring. Filthy and ragged at first (until 3.3), washed afterwards; the outfit is the same.
door.notes: Owner: prettier, curvier, more revealing within her patched fashion (option B).

marquis.name: The marquis de Carabas
marquis.lock: The marquis exactly as in his approved sheet: a tall lean Black British man, very dark skin, long locs tied back, a sudden white grin; the huge black dandy's coat with torn lace cuffs, ragged layers, square-toed boots, a gold watch chain. After his death (15.2 on): barefoot, a blanket worn as a poncho, a filthy cloth round his throat.

continuity.afterDeath: barefoot, a blanket worn as a poncho, a filthy cloth round his throat

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.lock: Hunter exactly as in her approved sheet: a tall Asian woman (Kazakh and Han Chinese), lean and curvy, sun-warmed golden-brown skin, high cheekbones, nut-brown eyes, a very long dark braid fading to tawny bronze; a thin sleeveless dappled grey-brown suede top laced at the sides, thin dappled leather leggings, knee boots, forearm wraps, hunting knife on a low belt, wrist torch, quarterstaff. Strong and sexy.
hunter.notes: Owner: recast as an Asian woman, lean and curvy, thinner fitted clothes (option A). From 17.3 she carries the bronze spear of faces.

croup.name: Mr Croup
croup.lock: Mr Croup exactly as in his sheet: thin, pallid, lank greasy unlikely-orange hair, faded china-blue eyes, a graveyard grin; a greasy black suit whose every seam is subtly wrong.

vandemar.name: Mr Vandemar
vandemar.lock: Mr Vandemar exactly as in his sheet: huge (about 2.05 m), bristle-cut grey-and-black hair, a blank face; the same wrong black suit; four raven-skull rings on his right hand.

islington.name: The Angel Islington
islington.lock: The Angel Islington exactly as in her sheet: a petite, curvy young woman, beautiful and alluring yet innocent and sweet-faced, evenly half Greek and half East Asian, pearl-grey eyes, long soft golden waves; a single length of thin, sheer, loosely woven ancient gauze linen pinned at one shoulder with a plain gold pin, falling to just below the knee, translucent; barefoot; no wings; candles light as she passes.
islington.notes: Owner: Islington is a woman, petite and curvy, hot but innocent-looking (a grown woman), 50-50 Greek and Asian face, dressed as the ancient world dressed: very little, thin sheer gauze; the innocence makes the betrayal in 20.3 land.

lamia.name: Lamia
lamia.lock: Lamia exactly as in her approved sheet: evenly half East Asian and half Greek, lean and curvy, very pale porcelain skin, foxglove eyes, plum lips, black hair in a Greek updo bound with white ribbons; thin white sheer Greek linen: a one-shoulder top pinned at the left shoulder leaving the midriff bare, a long sheer skirt low on the hips slit to the hip, silver armbands, bare feet. Her breath never mists. Sensual.
lamia.notes: Owner: lean and curvy, white thin Greek clothing, balanced half Asian half Greek, one-shoulder top (option A).

anaesthesia.name: Anaesthesia
anaesthesia.lock: Anaesthesia exactly as in her sheet: a British Filipina of nineteen who looks nineteen, small and thin, long ragged black hair, fur-trimmed rags, quartz-bead necklace, the red I AM 11 badge, a candle in a lemonade bottle; rats at her feet.
anaesthesia.notes: Remade so she looks nineteen (round 1 self-review).

oldbailey.name: Old Bailey
oldbailey.lock: Old Bailey exactly as in his sheet: short, round, grey muttonchops, a coat covered entirely in feathers, ropes wound round him, spectacles on a string.

abbot.name: The abbot
abbot.lock: The abbot exactly as in his sheet: a very old Black British friar, blind cataract eyes, short white beard, black Dominican habit, walking stick.

jessica.name: Jessica Bartram
jessica.lock: Jessica exactly as in her sheet: a British Korean woman of twenty-six, long dark chestnut corkscrew curls, a camel city coat over a black dress. At the museum (10.5): an off-the-shoulder green silk dress.

earl.name: The earl
earl.lock: The earl exactly as in his sheet: immense and elderly, the black patch over his LEFT eye, a red-grey beard, fur cap, wine-red fur-lined dressing gown, striped pyjamas, slippers.
earl.notes: Sheet mirrored so the patch is on his left eye, as in the novel.

ratspeaker.name: The Lord Rat-speaker
ratspeaker.lock: The Lord Rat-speaker exactly as in his sheet: tall, permanently stooped, long greasy hair, patchy beard, calico-fur-trimmed rags, a glass dagger; fingertips pressed together.
ratspeaker.heightNote: permanently stooped, so he stands about 1.65 m

varney.name: Varney
varney.lock: Varney exactly as in his sheet: a huge shaven-headed brute with ruined teeth, patched car-seat jacket, tattoos, a morning-star.

sable.name: Brother Sable
sable.lock: Brother Sable exactly as in his sheet: a tall powerful Black British friar, shaved head, black habit, quarterstaff; a split lip after Hunter.

beast.name: The Great Beast of London
beast.lock: The Great Beast exactly as in its sheet: a boar the size of a bull elephant, black-brown bristled hide stuck with broken spears and blades, two great curved boar tusks rising from the lower jaw (never horns), small red eyes. Always huge against people and tunnels.
beast.notes: Remade with proper boar tusks (round 1 self-review).
beast.heightNote: at the shoulder, about 6 m long

gary.name: Gary
gary.lock: Gary exactly as in his sheet: a British Chinese man of about thirty, neat gelled black hair, rimless glasses, grey office suit, loosened blue tie.

compgirl.name: The girl from Computer Services
compgirl.lock: The girl from Computer Services exactly as in her sheet: a British Malaysian Chinese woman of about twenty-eight, shoulder-length black hair with a fringe, a friendly round face, office casual.

oldwoman.name: The old woman with the umbrella
oldwoman.lock: The old woman exactly as in her sheet: tiny, very old, sharp eyes, wool hat, layers of coats and shawls; the white Tube-map umbrella.

tooley.name: Tooley
tooley.lock: Tooley exactly as in his sheet: an old painted jester in faded red-and-yellow motley.

iliaster.name: Iliaster
iliaster.lock: Iliaster exactly as in his sheet: short, old, balding, scraggly yellow-grey beard, dirt-lined face, a railwayman's lamp.

ross.name: Mr Ross
ross.lock: Mr Ross exactly as in his sheet: huge, hairless, grubby, filthy T-shirt and crusted jeans.

lear.name: Lear
lear.lock: Lear exactly as in his sheet: a very tall British Vietnamese busker, long forked black beard, saxophone.

serpentine.name: Serpentine
serpentine.lock: Serpentine exactly as in her sheet: a towering old woman, grey hair piled high, white leather corset and boots over a shredded lace wedding dress.

hammersmith.name: Hammersmith
hammersmith.lock: Hammersmith exactly as in his sheet: a Mongolian Londoner of about forty, huge, a topknot and a braided black beard, scorched leather apron.
hammersmith.notes: Redesigned so he resembles no real public figure (round 1 self-review).

fuliginous.name: Brother Fuliginous
fuliginous.lock: Brother Fuliginous exactly as in his sheet: a young slight Black British friar with a battered Polaroid camera.

portico.name: Lord Portico
portico.lock: Lord Portico exactly as in his sheet: Door's father, a thin British Chinese man of about sixty with her heart-shaped face, almost bald, threadbare smoking jacket, black skullcap. In Door's dream (12.1): younger, thick black hair, an easy smile.

arch-family.name: Door's mother, sister and brother
arch-family.lock: Door's mother, sister and brother exactly as in their group sheet, faintly translucent, like memories.

stockton.name: Mr Stockton
stockton.lock: Mr Stockton exactly as in his sheet: a British Hong Kong media magnate of about sixty, silver hair, rimless glasses, charcoal three-piece suit.

weasel.name: The Great Weasel
weasel.lock: The Great Weasel exactly as in its sheet: a weasel the size of a horse, glossy dark-brown fur, cream throat, fierce black eyes.
weasel.heightNote: at the shoulder, the size of a horse

longtail.name: Master Longtail
longtail.lock: Master Longtail: a large old dark brown rat (clan Gray) with a long pink tail, a grizzled muzzle and a torn left ear.
longtail.heightNote: nose to rump, the tail as long again
longtail.notes: Fact check 2026-10-24: the novel makes him dark brown, not black; the sheet needs remaking before approval.

misswhiskers.name: Miss Whiskers
misswhiskers.lock: Miss Whiskers exactly as in her sheet: a small sleek brown rat with very long white whiskers.

lucienne.name: Lucienne
lucienne.lock: Lucienne exactly as in her Sandman sheet.

death.name: Death
death.lock: Death exactly as in her Sandman sheet: Aurie's sister, in black, a silver ankh at her throat.
death.notes: From the Sandman; meets Aurie at every dead end.

daniel-dream.name: Daniel, the new Dream
daniel-dream.lock: Daniel exactly as in his Sandman sheet: white hair, white robe, starlight in his eyes.

hob.name: Hob Gadling
hob.lock: Hob exactly as in his Sandman sheet, in modern clothes outside the White Horse.

items: the Black Friars' silver key on a thread

background.crowd: Floating Market traders and buyers (a knight selling lost property, a dentist with a hand drill, dream sellers), described in the shot; faces kept small or turned away.
background.guards: Museum security guards in dark uniforms, described in the shot.
background.footman: A sleepy elderly footman in a faded livery at Down Street, described in the shot.
background.rat: Ordinary London rats (brown, about 25 cm nose to rump), described in the shot.

labyrinth.name: The labyrinth and the Fleet Marsh
labyrinth.look: The labyrinth under London: old brick sewer tunnels opening into the Fleet Marsh, a floor of mud and foul standing water, whining mosquitoes, lit only by a fitful yellow-amber flare.
labyrinth.scale: Brick tunnels about 4 m high and 4 m wide: a standing person reaches less than half way to the roof; the Beast's back nearly scrapes it.

library.name: Lucienne's library (from the Sandman)
library.look: Lucienne's library between worlds: tall dark bookshelves of books that were never written, a long wooden reading table with an oil lantern, drifting dust and sand, and in the far wall a row of doors from other stories: a dark plank door marked NEVERWHERE, a pale blue door marked CORALINE, a rough wooden door marked THE ALCHEMIST, a white door standing ajar on mist.
library.scale: Shelves about 5 m tall; each door an ordinary 2.1 m door; the reading table waist-high.

scottish-street.name: Outside the pub, Scotland
scottish-street.look: A narrow street in a small Scottish town at night, outside a pub with glowing windows; pelting rain, wet cobbles.
scottish-street.scale: The pub door is about 2 m high; the umbrella opens about 1 m across.

brick-wall.name: The pavement by the wall
brick-wall.look: A London pavement at night beside a high blank brick wall, street lamps, wet paving stones.
brick-wall.scale: The brick wall is about 4 m high; the door that opens in it is ordinary size, about 2 m.

orme-passage.name: Orme Passage
orme-passage.look: Orme Passage: a narrow alley that should not exist, one hissing gas jet, wet cobbles, a metal dustbin at the dead end.
orme-passage.scale: The alley is about 2 m wide; the dustbin is waist-high (about 1 m); the gas jet bracket is about 2.5 m up the wall.

tube-rush.name: A Tube platform at rush hour
tube-rush.look: A crowded London Underground platform, Monday morning rush hour, curved tiled walls, a train at the platform.
tube-rush.scale: Tube carriage doors are about 1.9 m high: a standing adult's head comes close to the top of the door.

aurie-flat.name: Aurie's flat
aurie-flat.look: Aurie's small rented flat at night: the narrow hallway and front door, stairwell light beyond.
aurie-flat.scale: The hallway is about 1 m wide; the front door about 2 m high; a wall telephone at shoulder height.

death-grey.name: The grey edge of the dream
death-grey.look: A quiet grey nowhere at the edge of a dream: completely empty, no buildings, ruins, doors or furniture, only soft grey mist over a smooth pale grey floor, fading to white with no horizon, soft even light.
death-grey.scale: No objects at all; the mist begins a few metres away; a person stands at ordinary height, camera at adult eye level.

ratspeaker-hall.name: The Rat-speakers' hall
ratspeaker-hall.look: The Rat-speakers' hall under London: greasy fires, rat holes in every wall, people lying prostrate before a single rat.
ratspeaker-hall.scale: Rat holes are fist-sized; a rat is about 25 to 30 cm nose to rump; trestles are waist-high.

portico-study.name: Portico's study, the House Without Doors
portico-study.look: The study in the House Without Doors: a stuffed crocodile on the ceiling, an astrolabe, a bust of Portico, a brown stain; on the desk the journal machine, a cabinet of walnut, brass and prisms with a gramophone horn and a small screen.
portico-study.scale: The desk is waist-high; the journal machine's screen is about the size of a hardback book; the crocodile on the ceiling is about 3 m long.

nights-bridge.name: Night's Bridge
nights-bridge.look: Night's Bridge: a narrow medieval stone span into total black, no sky, no water.
nights-bridge.scale: The bridge is about 2 m wide with waist-high (about 1 m) stone parapets.

harrods-market.name: The Floating Market in Harrods
harrods-market.look: The Floating Market in Harrods' Egyptian Room at night: thousands of lights, stalls set on the shop counters, curry smoke, open fires, a jostling crowd of London Below.
harrods-market.scale: Shop counters are waist-high (about 1 m); the hall's ceiling is about 6 m.

spiral-stair.name: The 259 steps
spiral-stair.look: The bottom of a disused Tube station's spiral staircase: metal railings, a sign warning of 259 steps, steel lift doors.
spiral-stair.scale: Each step about 18 cm high; railings waist-high; the lift doors about 2.1 m high.

great-hall.name: Islington's Great Hall
great-hall.look: Islington's Great Hall: rock walls, iron pillars running into the dark, a waterfall into a small rock-pool, hundreds of candles, a huge door of black flint set in silver tarnished almost black between two iron pillars.
great-hall.scale: Iron pillars about 8 m tall; the black flint door about 4 m tall, more than twice a person's height; candles stand knee- to waist-high; the rock-pool about 2 m across.

central-line.name: A Central Line platform
central-line.look: A Central Line platform at night, a few late passengers, posters for films and underwear, the recorded voice: Mind the Gap.
central-line.scale: About 3 m from the platform edge to the back wall; Tube carriage doors about 1.9 m high.

museum-storeroom.name: The museum storeroom
museum-storeroom.look: A museum storeroom: a dim hall crowded with junk, crates and statues on plinths.
museum-storeroom.scale: Plinths about 1 m high, so a man standing on one has his head far above everyone else's; crates chest-high.

museum-hall.name: The Angels over England party
museum-hall.look: The museum's exhibition hall during the Angels over England party: guests in evening dress, drinks, and on a stage the Angelus, an enormous carved cathedral door.
museum-hall.scale: The stage is about 1 m high; the Angelus is about 5 m tall, nearly three times a person's height.

cellar.name: The cellar of maggots
cellar.look: A dank cellar: dripping water, rustling maggots, one lantern.
cellar.scale: The ceiling is about 2.3 m, low over a tall man's head; the figurine fits in two cupped hands (about 20 cm).

blackfriars-marsh.name: The marsh before the Black Friars' bridge
blackfriars-marsh.look: A marsh in thick yellow fog at the foot of the Black Friars' bridge rising out of the mist; muddy water.
blackfriars-marsh.scale: The bridge parapet is waist-high; the water ankle- to knee-deep; a quarterstaff is as tall as the man who holds it.

blackfriars-platform.name: Blackfriars station
blackfriars-platform.look: Blackfriars Underground station: a dim platform, BLACKFRIARS on the tiled wall, posters on the far wall across the tracks.
blackfriars-platform.scale: Tube carriage doors about 1.9 m high; the posters across the tracks about 3 m wide.

friars-crypt.name: The crypt of those who failed
friars-crypt.look: A low, crypt-like room under the Black Friars' abbey, candlelit: a long wall of portraits of those who failed the Ordeal, Polaroids among sepia prints, pencil sketches and painted miniatures.
friars-crypt.scale: The ceiling is low, about 2.2 m; each picture is palm-sized.

london-wall.name: The London Wall at Tower Hill
london-wall.look: The top of a remnant of the old Roman London Wall near Tower Hill at night, moonlight, the Thames beyond.
london-wall.scale: The wall stands about 4 m high and is about 2.4 m wide on top, room for a body laid out with space beside it.

down-street.name: Down Street's well
down-street.look: Down Street: a vast inside-out Tower of Babel, a bottomless well about 40 m across, its rock walls carved with an ornate spiral road winding down for thousands of feet, dim lamps along the road, tiny fires far, far below; an old lift cage hangs at the top beside a narrow wooden ledge, and a single long plank bridges the drop from the ledge to the top of the spiral road.
down-street.scale: The well is about 40 m across and thousands of feet deep; the plank is about 30 cm wide and 6 m long, a thin line over the drop; the ledge by the lift no wider than a plank; the lift cage about 2.2 m high; the spiral road about 3 m wide; the fires far below are pinpricks.

westminster.name: The island of Westminster
westminster.look: The island of Westminster at dawn: long grass white with melting frost, a small hill, the Thames beyond, wheeling gulls.
westminster.scale: The grass is knee-high; the hill a gentle slope about 15 m long, so a person at the top is still clearly readable.

trafalgar.name: Trafalgar Square
trafalgar.look: Trafalgar Square on a warm October mid-morning: blue sky, Nelson's Column, the Landseer lions, red buses and black taxis, tourists feeding legions of tubby pigeons.
trafalgar.scale: Nelson's Column about 52 m; each lion about 6 m long on a high plinth; a pigeon about 30 cm.

brewer-wall.name: The wall off Brewer Street
brewer-wall.look: A dark brick wall in a narrow street off Brewer Street, Soho, at night; a door shape scratched into the bricks.
brewer-wall.scale: The scratched door shape is about 2 m high, just taller than a person.

market-b.name: The next Floating Market
market-b.look: A Floating Market in a lantern-lit underground hall: stalls, smoke, traders, a crowd of London Below.
market-b.scale: Trestles waist-high; lanterns hung about 3 m up.

dream-throne.name: The throne room of the Dreaming (from the Sandman)
dream-throne.look: The throne room of the Dreaming: a vast floor of polished black glass inlaid with fine silver lines, walls of night sky full of stars, a high black throne with one candle beside it, pale gates with antler-like spires far behind.
dream-throne.scale: The throne about 2.5 m tall; the gates about 4 m; the candle stand waist-high.

tunnels.name: Under London: the old tunnels
tunnels.look: Under London: old stone and brick service tunnels, damp walls, puddles on the floor, a low burrow cut into a side wall, one lamp far off, and a blind end of plain brick.
tunnels.scale: Tunnels about 2.5 m high and 2 m wide, a tall man's head close to the roof; the burrow about 1 m high.

office.name: Aurie's office off the Strand
office.look: Aurie's open-plan office off the Strand on a Friday evening: rows of desks with grey monitors and in-trays, strip lights, windows onto wet London streets at dusk.
office.scale: Desks waist-high; the ceiling about 2.8 m; the windows about 2 m tall.

ladder-tower.name: The ladder up the tower
ladder-tower.look: The outside of a stone tower a thousand feet above London in daylight: a rusted iron ladder bolted to the sheer wall, the whole city spread far below, wind.
ladder-tower.scale: Rungs about 30 cm apart, the ladder about 50 cm wide: one person fills it; the city below is tiny.

rooftops.name: Old Bailey's rooftops
rooftops.look: Old Bailey's rooftops: slate roofs and chimney stacks of old London at dusk, a tent of tarpaulin and rope, a small fire with a cooking pot, starlings and pigeons.
rooftops.scale: Chimney stacks about 2 m above the roof; the tent about 2 m high; the pot knee-high.

flat-living.name: Aurie's flat: living room and kitchen
flat-living.look: Aurie's small rented flat, the living room and kitchenette: a sofa, a television with shelves of videotapes, a window over a London street with red buses, a little kitchenette with a sink and a kettle.
flat-living.scale: The ceiling about 2.5 m; the sink waist-high; the window about 1.5 m tall.

flat-bathroom.name: Aurie's flat: the bathroom
flat-bathroom.look: Aurie's small bathroom: white tiles, a bathtub with a shower curtain pushed back, a sink and a mirror, spotlessly empty.
flat-bathroom.scale: The bath about 1.7 m long and knee-high; the sink waist-high.

penthouse.name: The penthouse
penthouse.look: Aurie's new penthouse flat on a Saturday morning: floor-to-ceiling windows over London, packing cases half emptied.
penthouse.scale: The ceiling about 3 m; packing cases knee-high.
